segments.text: THe Lord heare thee in the day of trouble: the name of the God of Iacob defende thee.
Sende thee helpe from the Sanctuary: and ſtrength thee out of Sion.
Remember all thy offerynges: and accepte thy brente ſacrifice
Graunte thee thy heartes deſyre: and fulfyll all thy mynde.
We will reioyce in thy ſaluacion, and tryumphe in the name of the Lorde oure God: the Lorde perfourme all thy peticions.
Now knowe I that the Lorde helpeth hys anoynted, and will heare him from hys holye heauen: euen with the wholeſome ſtrength of his right hand.
Some put their truſt in Chariotes, and ſome in horſes: but we will remembre the name of the Lorde our God.
They are brought downe and fallen: but we are riſen and ſtand vpright.
Saue Lorde, and heare vs, O kyng of heauen: when we call vpon thee.
Glory be to the father, and to the ſonne. &c.
As it was in the beginning. &c.
